svg.title: The curve is the model; the threshold is a business decision
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “The curve is the model; the threshold is a business decision” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A logistic S-curve drawn through eighteen pass and fail study-hour points, with a red dashed vertical threshold at 2.710 hours carrying a slider handle and a double-headed arrow, beside two insets contrasting the clean log-loss bowl with a crossed-out flat-shelved squared-error curve at curvature -0.120, and two arrows of wildly different length showing a 203-times gradient difference on the same wrong point.
svg.text: The curve is the model; the threshold is a business decision
draw it from memory, then compare
